text: This staff report is about a matter for which Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting that North York Community Council rescind the existing weekday, daytime parking prohibition on the north side of Victory Drive, fronting 2800 Keele Street, and that three-hour parking be permitted. The proposed parking amendment will address the residents' concerns with the lack of daytime on-street parking spaces for their guests and visitors and will provide approximately nine daytime on-street parking spaces on the north side of the subject section of Victory Drive.

North York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing parking prohibition in effect from 6:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the north side of Victory Drive, between a point 42 metres east of Pleasant Home Boulevard and Keele Street.
